sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (389.12) with same-day FOMC event creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 8 days adds moderate binary risk; yield curve normal but insufficient to offset volatility spike.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (22.5–25.8) combined with supertrend bullish signal and squeeze positive in fear-zone market (VIX 34) creates contrarian mean-reversion setup near support (97.28).
debate.key_bear_argument: Confirmed death cross, price below all major moving averages, bearish MACD, weak money flow (CMF −0.1969), zero fundamental conviction, FOMC event same-day, earnings in 8 days, and VIX crisis regime (389.12) create overwhelming macro and technical headwinds that invalidate isolated oversold signals.
